description: React component for contour control in a visualization, managing contours with add, remove, edit, and reorder functionalities, including popover UI interactions.

classes.name: ContourControl
classes.description: React component managing contour configurations with UI interactions.

methods.name: togglePopover
methods.description: Sets the visibility state of the popover.

methods.name: handleClickGhostButton
methods.description: Handles click event to show the contour addition popover.

methods.name: saveContour
methods.description: Adds a new contour to the list and closes the popover.

methods.name: removeContour
methods.description: Removes a contour at a specified index.

methods.name: onShiftContour
methods.description: Reorders contours by swapping two indices.

methods.name: editContour
methods.description: Updates a contour at a specific index.

methods.name: valuesRenderer
methods.description: Renders the list of contour options.
